faq: Apakah perlu WiFi atau listrik di lokasi?
Menurut brosur, kamera ditenagai panel surya dan baterai serta terhubung lewat 4G, sehingga tidak butuh WiFi atau listrik jaringan. Cakupan sinyal 4G di lokasi tetap harus dicek.
Apakah rekaman tersimpan?
Kamera mendukung penyimpanan cloud untuk video alarm dan kartu TF hingga 128 GB. Rekaman penuh sepanjang waktu tidak dijadwalkan dalam brosur; sistem mengutamakan perekaman saat ada deteksi.
Bagaimana jika cuaca mendung berhari-hari?
Baterai 8000 mAh menyimpan cadangan, tetapi pengisian bergantung pada sinar matahari. Lokasi yang terlalu teduh atau sering mendung mungkin butuh solusi lain.
Apakah perlu kartu SIM?
Kamera terhubung lewat 4G, sehingga kartu SIM dan paket data kemungkinan diperlukan. Konfirmasi dalam penawaran.

Harga mengikuti penawaran resmi dari pabrikan. Hubungi Sentra untuk meminta penawaran.

en.title: Solar 4G Wireless CCTV Camera (GDKJ-D440) | Sentra
en.description: Procurement of solar-powered 4G CCTV cameras for sites without power or WiFi: 2K resolution, 355° pan, PIR human detection, colour night vision, monitoring from a phone.
en.name: Solar 4G CCTV Camera
en.h1: Solar-powered 4G CCTV cameras for sites without power or WiFi.
en.lead: Sentra is an official partner of PT GIDA International Trading Indonesia and supplies the GDKJ-D440 camera: a dual-lens 2K camera powered by a solar panel and battery, connected over 4G and monitored from a phone. Suited to plantations, projects, warehouses and temporary sites.
en.wa_text: Hello Sentra, I would like advice on solar 4G CCTV cameras for our site.
en.pains_h2: Problems we see in the field
pains: Sites with no power and no network cable
Running cable to a plantation, project or remote warehouse is too costly.
Cameras stop when power fails
Cameras that depend on mains power or WiFi go dark when needed.
Theft at temporary sites
Materials, tools and harvest need watching without permanent installation.
No idea what happened while away
Owners need alerts and recordings that open from a phone.
do: Site consultation
Viewing angle, sun exposure and 4G signal at the site decide suitability.
Procurement of solar 4G cameras
The GDKJ-D440 with solar panel, battery and 4G connectivity, per official quotation.
App and alert setup
Connection to the iCam365 app and human-detection notification settings.
Placement and mounting
Position and height that capture the key area and receive sunlight.
Combination with wired CCTV
Paired with Sentra's VIGI cameras and NVR at points cable can reach.
Support after purchase
Technical questions are passed on under the manufacturer's terms.
en.kits_lead: Key GDKJ-D440 specifications from the GIDA brochure. Prices follow the official quotation; request one via WhatsApp.
sectors: Guard posts, harvest stores and access far from the power grid.
Watching materials and tools at temporary sites.
Cable-free points that ordinary installation cannot easily reach.
steps: Define the points and areas to watch
Choose the number of cameras and request an official quotation
Regular check of panel and battery
faq: Does the site need WiFi or power?
According to the brochure, the camera runs on a solar panel and battery and connects over 4G, so it needs neither WiFi nor grid power. 4G coverage at the site must still be checked.
Is footage recorded?
The camera supports cloud storage for alarm videos and a TF card up to 128 GB. The brochure does not describe round-the-clock recording; the system prioritises recording on detection.
What about several cloudy days?
The 8000 mAh battery stores a reserve, but charging depends on sunlight. A very shaded or often cloudy site may need another solution.
Is a SIM card needed?
The camera connects over 4G, so a SIM card and data plan are likely needed. Confirm in the quotation.
How much does it cost?
Price follows the manufacturer's official quotation. Contact Sentra to request one.
en.cta_h2: Need a camera for a site without power?
en.cta_p: Tell us the location, the area to watch and the mobile signal available. The first discussion is free.

太阳能 4G 摄像头采购
带太阳能板、电池和 4G 连接的 GDKJ-D440，以正式报价为准。
应用与提醒设置

位置与安装

faq: 现场需要 WiFi 或电源吗？
根据产品册，摄像头由太阳能板和电池供电，并通过 4G 联网，因此无需 WiFi 或市电。现场的 4G 覆盖仍需确认。
会录像吗？
摄像头支持报警视频的云存储和最高 128 GB 的 TF 卡。产品册未描述全天候录像，系统以检测触发录像为主。
连续几天阴天怎么办？
8000 mAh 电池可储备电量，但充电依赖阳光。过于阴暗或常阴天的场所可能需要其他方案。
需要 SIM 卡吗？
摄像头通过 4G 联网，可能需要 SIM 卡和流量套餐，请在报价中确认。
价格是多少？
价格以制造商正式报价为准，请联系 Sentra 索取。

ko.wa_text: 안녕하세요 Sentra, 저희 현장의 태양광 4G CCTV 카메라 상담을 원합니다.
pains: 전기도 네트워크 케이블도 없는 현장
농장, 프로젝트, 외진 창고까지 케이블을 까는 비용이 너무 큽니다.
정전되면 카메라가 멈춤
상용 전원이나 WiFi에 의존하는 카메라는 필요할 때 꺼집니다.
임시 현장의 도난
자재, 공구, 수확물을 영구 설치 없이 감시해야 합니다.
자리를 비웠을 때 무슨 일이 있었는지 모름
휴대폰으로 열 수 있는 알림과 녹화가 필요합니다.
do: 현장 상담
현장의 시야각, 일조량, 4G 신호가 적합성을 정합니다.

sectors: 전력망에서 먼 초소, 수확물 창고, 진입로.
steps: 카메라 수 결정 및 공식 견적 요청
faq: 현장에 WiFi나 전기가 필요한가요?
브로셔에 따르면 카메라는 태양광 패널과 배터리로 작동하고 4G로 연결되므로 WiFi나 상용 전원이 필요 없습니다. 현장의 4G 커버리지는 확인해야 합니다.
영상이 저장되나요?
경보 영상용 클라우드 저장과 최대 128GB TF 카드를 지원합니다. 브로셔는 24시간 상시 녹화를 설명하지 않으며 감지 시 녹화를 우선합니다.
며칠 동안 흐리면 어떻게 되나요?
8000mAh 배터리가 예비 전력을 저장하지만 충전은 햇빛에 달려 있습니다. 그늘이 많거나 자주 흐린 곳은 다른 방법이 필요할 수 있습니다.
SIM 카드가 필요한가요?
4G로 연결되므로 SIM 카드와 데이터 요금제가 필요할 수 있습니다. 견적에서 확인하세요.
가격은 얼마인가요?
제조사의 공식 견적에 따릅니다. Sentra에 견적을 요청하세요.
ko.cta_p: 위치, 감시 구역, 사용 가능한 이동통신 신호를 알려 주세요. 첫 상담은 무료입니다.

Titik tanpa wayar yang sukar dicapai pemasangan biasa.
steps: Tentukan titik dan kawasan yang dipantau
Pilih bilangan kamera dan mohon sebut harga rasmi
faq: Adakah lokasi memerlukan WiFi atau elektrik?
Menurut risalah, kamera berkuasa panel suria dan bateri serta bersambung melalui 4G, jadi tidak memerlukan WiFi atau elektrik grid. Liputan 4G di lokasi tetap perlu disemak.
Adakah rakaman disimpan?
Kamera menyokong storan awan untuk video penggera dan kad TF sehingga 128 GB.
Bagaimana jika mendung beberapa hari?
Bateri 8000 mAh menyimpan simpanan, tetapi pengecasan bergantung pada cahaya matahari.
Adakah kad SIM diperlukan?
Kamera bersambung melalui 4G, jadi kad SIM dan pelan data mungkin diperlukan.
Berapakah harganya?
Harga mengikut sebut harga rasmi pengilang.
ms.cta_h2: Perlukan kamera untuk lokasi tanpa elektrik?
ms.cta_p: Beritahu kami lokasi, kawasan yang dipantau dan isyarat selular yang ada. Perbincangan awal percuma.

card.desc: Kamera CCTV suria 4G 2K untuk lokasi tanpa elektrik dan WiFi, dipantau dari telefon.
